name: Api Contract Compatibility Guard
summary: Block high-confidence removals from bounded OpenAPI contract edits.
description: Compares OpenAPI JSON or indentation-stable YAML signatures and blocks removed routes, operations, response codes, and newly mandatory parameters without executing generators.
refuses: It does not call an API or regenerate clients.
It does not infer undocumented consumer behavior.
It does not approve a breaking-version release.

entrypoints.purpose: Block high-confidence removals from bounded OpenAPI contract edits.
